The single most important speed rule: feed a steam-base multiblock superheated steam and it runs at 4x speed while drinking 4x the steam. Works on bronze tier too — there is no tier gate.

Exceptions worth memorizing: the Siemens-Martin Furnace requires superheated steam outright; the Singularity Drilling Hub requires it but gets NO speedup; the Kinetic Processing Array is superheated-only by design.

Make superheated steam with the Gear Steam Compressor (chapter 3) or a chipped geothermal boiler.
